routes.requirements: 18+, US resident, phone number or email (no card needed), smartphone

catches: Points expire after 90 days of inactivity (60-day warning by email/text)

Points have no cash value and cannot be redeemed for cash, transferred, or combined
Minimum Redemption Amount can change at any time at Fetch's sole discretion
Fetch may limit the number of receipts processed in a time period

steps.text: Download the official Fetch Rewards app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store (free).
Open the app and create an account with your email (or Google/Facebook login); provide your name and a valid mobile phone number.
Optionally enter a friend's referral code on the signup screen for bonus points.
After any grocery, restaurant, gas, or retail purchase, tap the camera icon in the app and photograph the full receipt within 14 days.
Optionally link your email and Amazon accounts under the eReceipts section so online purchase receipts earn automatically.
Check the Special Offers tab for bonus-point offers on specific brands before you shop.
Once your balance reaches at least 3,000 points, open the Rewards tab, pick a gift card (e.g. $3 Amazon), tap Get My Reward, and find the gift card under My Rewards / your email.

Microsoft Store purchases: subscriptions and gift card purchases are not eligible; 20,000 points/month cap on purchase earnings

Complete the daily quizzes, polls, and streak activities on your Rewards dashboard for bonus points.
Keep earning at least 500 points per month to reach and hold Level 2 for better rates.
Once you reach 1,600+ points, open the Rewards catalog and redeem for a Microsoft Store/Xbox gift card (or save to 5,000 for top-retailer gift cards).

routes.what: Search ISBN, compare buyback prices, ship textbook, receive payment
routes.reward: Comparison tool for textbook buyback prices (varies per book; BookFinder is not itself a buyer — no fixed $200)
routes.requirements: Active student status, .edu email or student ID, may need verification through SheerID
routes.payout_timing: BookFinder pays nothing itself; timing depends on the buyback vendor you select from the comparison.
catches: BookFinder never buys your book — it only compares other vendors' buyback offers; you complete the sale with a third party.
Buyback value varies per book, edition, condition, and vendor — the $200 headline is unsupported and unrealistic for most books.
Older editions and low-demand titles may get no offers at all.

steps.text: Go to https://www.bookfinder.com/ and use the 'Textbook Buyback' option in the For Students section.
Search by ISBN to get the exact edition of your textbook.
Compare the buyback offers from the listed vendors, including shipping costs.
Pick the best offer and click through to that vendor's site.
Follow the vendor's own sell process (enter condition, accept quote, ship with their label).
Track the vendor's payment timing — BookFinder has no role after you leave its site.

routes.what: Enter ISBN, get quote, ship free, receive payment
routes.reward: Chegg no longer buys books (since mid-2022) — selling routes through Valore's marketplace (functional duplicate of R0368)
routes.requirements: Active student status, .edu email or student ID, may need verification through SheerID
routes.payout_timing: Chegg pays nothing itself; sales complete on Valore's marketplace — Valore issues payment within 14 business days of warehouse processing (check via USPS 7-14 days, PayPal 2-14 days).
catches: Chegg does not buy your book — since 2022 all textbook selling is routed to Valore's marketplace, making this route functionally identical to Valore sellback.
Payout varies per book and condition — the $200 headline is unsupported.
Payment comes from Valore (check or PayPal), not Chegg, and can take weeks.

steps.text: Start your search at https://www.chegg.com/books for the textbook you want to sell.
Chegg redirects book listings and purchases to Valore's marketplace product pages.
On the Valore page, get your sellback quote for the book (amount varies by title and condition).
Accept the quote, use the prepaid shipping label, and ship within 7 days of the quote.
Valore's warehouse receives and evaluates the book; payment is issued within 14 business days.
Receive payment by check (USPS, 7-14 business days) or PayPal (2-14 business days).

routes.what: Enter ISBN, get quote, ship free, receive payment
routes.reward: Textbook buyback with prepaid label (ship within 7 days); payment within 14 business days of processing — check 7-14d or PayPal 2-14d; quote varies per book
routes.requirements: Active student status, .edu email or student ID, may need verification through SheerID
routes.payout_timing: Payment issued within 14 business days of warehouse processing; check arrives 7-14 business days via USPS, PayPal posts 2-14 business days.
catches: Payout varies per book, edition, condition, and demand — the $200 headline is unsupported; many books quote far less.
Books must be shipped within 7 days of the quote; prepaid labels expire after 10 days.
If the book's condition doesn't match your description, the quote can be revised down.
Full cycle (quote, ship, warehouse evaluation, payment) takes weeks.

steps.text: Go to https://www.valore.com/sellback and enter your textbook's ISBN to get a sellback quote.
Accept the quote if the price works for you (quotes vary per book and condition).
Use Valore's prepaid shipping label and ship the book within 7 days of receiving the quote.
Valore's warehouse receives and evaluates the book against your stated condition.
Payment is issued within 14 business days of warehouse processing.
Receive payment by check (USPS, 7-14 business days) or PayPal (2-14 business days).

Amazon's third-party merchant receives and verifies the book's condition.
An Amazon.com gift card for the agreed value is deposited into your Amazon account.

routes.reward: Up to $1.00 in Google Play credit per survey
routes.requirements: Varies by app: 18+, US resident, smartphone or computer, email account
routes.payout_timing: Credit added when the survey is completed
catches: Surveys arrive roughly once a week and availability is inconsistent — you cannot count on volume.

The per-survey amount is small (a few cents up to $1.00).

The old consumer web page (surveys.google.com/opinion-rewards) now redirects to a Google Surveys sunset notice — the app is the product, and Google confirms the Opinion Rewards app itself is not going away.

steps.text: On Android, open the Play Store and install 'Google Opinion Rewards' by Google LLC; on iPhone, install it from the App Store.
Open the app and sign in with your Google account (on iOS, connect your PayPal account during setup).
Answer the initial profile questions about yourself (age, gender, location, interests) so surveys can be matched to you.
Turn on notifications — surveys arrive about once a week and can expire quickly.
When a survey notification arrives, open it and answer the questions honestly (most take 10-30 seconds).
Your credit (up to $1.00 per survey) is added to your Play balance on Android, or accumulates toward PayPal payout on iOS.
On Android, spend the credit in the Play Store — it applies automatically at checkout for apps, games, movies, or subscriptions.

steps.text: Cash out when you reach the minimum payout threshold

routes.method: Search for unclaimed property held by state governments
routes.what: Search by name and state, file claim with documentation
routes.reward: Varies by claim; average claim about $2,080
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Weeks to months depending on the state
catches: Only finds money if unclaimed property exists in your name — most searches return no match.
Hawaii does not participate in MissingMoney.com (the site links you to Hawaii's own system).
You file the actual claim with the state treasury/controller holding the funds, not with MissingMoney — the state requires ID and proof of address.
No payout timeline is published; state processing commonly takes weeks to months.

steps.text: Go to https://missingmoney.com/ in your browser.
Type your last name (or business name) and first name into the search boxes and tap Search.
Repeat the search for every state you have lived or worked in; also try previous names and common misspellings (the site explicitly recommends this).
Open any match and check the details (old address, holder name) to confirm the property is really yours.
Tap through to initiate the claim — the site redirects you to the official state treasury/controller website holding the funds.
Submit the state's claim form with your photo ID and proof of address directly to the state.
Wait for the state to verify and pay you; check back often since new properties are added daily.

routes.method: Search for and file claims in class action settlements
routes.what: Search settlement databases, file claim with proof of purchase
routes.requirements: 18+ (or guardian for minors), US resident, government ID, proof of address, patience for processing timelines
routes.payout_timing: Typically months after final court approval
catches: No single official database covers every class action — the FTC page covers FTC-administered cases only; other cases live on their own official settlement websites.
Third-party aggregator sites are leads only — always file on the official settlement website run by the court-appointed administrator.
Each case has a hard claim deadline; missing it means no payout.
Payouts are often small (single-digit to tens of dollars for consumer cases) and arrive months after the final approval hearing.
Scam sites mimic settlement notices — the FTC states it will never threaten you, demand money to release a refund, or promise a prize.

steps.text: Go to https://www.ftc.gov/enforcement/refunds and scan the Active Refund Programs table for a company or product you used.
For non-FTC class actions, search the web for the case name plus 'official settlement website' — open the administrator's site (Epiq, Kroll, JND, etc.), never a random blog.
On the official settlement website, read the class definition to confirm you qualify (dates, product, state).
Check the claim deadline and what proof is required (receipt, account email, or no proof needed).
Fill out the official online claim form with truthful information — false claims can be rejected and may lead to penalties.
Choose your payment method if offered (check, PayPal, Venmo, prepaid card).
Save your confirmation number and wait — payments typically arrive months after the final approval hearing.

routes.method: Complete academic research studies for universities
routes.what: Sign up, complete profile, participate in studies
routes.reward: At least $8/hr — researchers must pay a minimum of £6/$8 per hour
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident (varies), honest profile, PayPal account, quiet room for tests, smartphone or computer
routes.payout_timing: Paid after researcher approves; cash out from $6/£6 via PayPal
catches: New signups currently join a waitlist — you are invited only when tasks are available.
Study flow depends on researcher demand matching your demographics; earnings are not steady.
Researchers can reject submissions, which means no pay for that study.
Some studies may effectively underpay if they take longer than the researcher's estimate (Prolific polices this via median-time recalculation).

steps.text: Go to https://www.prolific.com/participants and click Sign up to join the waitlist (about 3 minutes: email, password, basic info).
Watch for the invite email and accept it when tasks become available for your profile.
Verify your identity with a photo ID (about 15 minutes) and complete the short practice task.
Fill out the 'About you' profile questions — these decide which studies you are offered.
Open your Studies dashboard, pick a study, and check its stated reward and estimated time before starting.
Complete the study in one sitting, following the instructions, then submit your responses.
Once the researcher approves and your balance reaches $6/£6, cash out from your Prolific account to PayPal.

routes.method: Test websites and apps by completing recorded tasks
routes.what: Apply, pass practice test, take tests
routes.reward: $10 per 15-20 min test; $4 short tests; $30-$120 live interviews
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident (varies), honest profile, PayPal account, quiet room for tests, smartphone or computer
routes.payout_timing: PayPal, usually 14 days after the test; no minimum
catches: Test availability is inconsistent and demographic-gated — most contributors get only a few tests per week.
The practice test is unpaid and your first real test is manually reviewed before you can take more.
You must wait about 14 days after each test for the PayPal payment.
Payments can be cancelled if the customer is dissatisfied and the quality review upholds it.
UserTesting does not withhold taxes — you are responsible for reporting the income.

steps.text: Go to https://usertesting.com/be-a-user-tester and enter your email address to start the application.
Complete the applicant checklist: take the short practice test (unpaid) — on a computer no download is needed; on a phone, download the UserTesting app from the App Store or Google Play first.
Create your account with your name, username, password, and zip code, and link a verified PayPal account.
Wait for your first test to be manually reviewed and scored — only then can you take more tests.
Check your dashboard for available tests; every listing shows the exact amount you will be paid before you accept.
Complete the test: follow the tasks, speak your thoughts aloud clearly, and upload the recording.
Your payment is sent to PayPal, usually 14 days after you complete the test — track it under Test history.

Buy and install the qualifying efficient equipment within the program window and keep receipts.
Submit the utility's rebate application (online or mail-in) with proof of purchase; rebate arrives as a bill credit or check, typically in 4-8 weeks.

catches: The federal EV charger tax credit (30%, up to $1,000) EXPIRED June 30, 2026 — do not promise it for new installations.
What remains are state and utility rebates that vary by location; many areas have nothing.
Every incentive requires buying and installing a charger ($500-$2,000+) first — a discount on spending, not money earned.
AFDC's own disclaimer: verify each incentive is still applicable before acting.

steps.text: Go to https://afdc.energy.gov/laws and search incentives for your state, filtering for electric-vehicle charging infrastructure.
Open each listed program and confirm it is currently funded and accepting applications — do not rely on the AFDC summary alone.
Also check your electric utility's website for charger rebates not listed federally.
Buy and install a qualifying Level 2 charger per the program's rules (some require pre-approval or a licensed electrician).
Submit the rebate application or claim the tax treatment per the program's instructions; keep all receipts and installation dates.

routes.method: Search for heat pump installation rebates and tax credits
routes.what: Search federal/state programs, apply for rebate or tax credit
routes.reward: Federal $2,000 credit EXPIRED 12/31/2025 — do not expect it for new 2026 work. Live money is state/utility rebates (e.g., NY: $700-$1,400 per 10k Btu/h + $1,000 HPWH, funded through 2030); purchase discount, not income
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: Rebate applied at point of sale or paid through the participating contractor, typically within weeks of installation; varies by utility territory.
catches: The $2,000 federal heat-pump tax credit (25C) EXPIRED December 31, 2025 under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act — it is not available for 2026 installations.
Remaining rebates are state/utility-specific and vary from a few hundred to several thousand dollars; there is no national $2,000 offer anymore.
You must purchase a $5,000-$15,000+ system first — this is a discount on spending, not money earned.
Most programs require a participating contractor; DIY or non-listed equipment does not qualify.

steps.text: Look up heat-pump rebates for your zip code at https://dsireusa.org and on your electric/gas utility's website — amounts and rules are local.
Confirm the current program is funded and accepting applications (e.g., NYS Clean Heat runs through 2030; check your own state's status).
Get quotes only from contractors participating in your local rebate program and confirm the equipment model is on the program's qualifying list.
Install the qualifying heat-pump system; the rebate is applied at point of sale or paid through the contractor after installation.
Do NOT claim the federal 25C credit for any system placed in service after December 31, 2025 — it no longer exists.

routes.method: Apply for federal energy assistance if eligible
routes.what: Apply through state LIHEAP office with income documentation
routes.reward: Bill assistance: official averages $380 heating / $583 cooling, paid to the utility (not cash; income at or below 150% FPL or 60% state median income)
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: Each state runs seasonal application windows; once approved, the benefit is paid directly to the household's energy vendor, typically within weeks. Crisis assistance for shutoff emergencies is expedited.
catches: You never receive cash — LIHEAP pays your energy company directly. It is bill assistance, not income.
The national average heating benefit is about $380, far below the route's $1,000 top end.
Income-restricted: at or below 150% of the poverty line (or 60% of state median income).
Funding is limited — only a fraction of eligible households are served each year.
Applications are only open during each state's seasonal window; miss it and you wait a year.

steps.text: Confirm your household income is at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (or 60% of your state's median income).

Find your state's LIHEAP office and its current application window via the ACF LIHEAP guidance hub at https://acf.gov/ocs/policy-guidance/liheap-im2026-01-federal-poverty-guidelines-fpg-and-state-median-income-smi (follow links to state contacts).
Apply during the open window with income documentation, ID, and a recent energy bill.
If approved, the benefit is credited to your energy account by the vendor — no check comes to you.
If facing a shutoff, ask about crisis assistance, which is processed faster.

routes.method: Apply for free home weatherization if income-eligible
routes.what: Apply through state weatherization office with income documentation
routes.reward: Free weatherization services; DOE cites $372+/yr average energy savings (savings, not cash; income at or below 200% federal poverty level)
routes.requirements: US resident, may need to be utility customer, proof of purchase required, processing time varies
routes.payout_timing: No fixed payout — free weatherization services are scheduled after application approval; state-agency waitlists of several months are typical; savings accrue as lower energy bills.
catches: This pays $0 in cash — you receive free home improvements and lower bills, not money. It is savings, not income.
Income-restricted: at or below 200% of the federal poverty line. An average user above that line gets nothing.
State-administered with limited slots (~32,000 homes/year nationally per DOE) — waitlists of months are normal.
Renters need written landlord permission before any work.
DOE publishes no per-home dollar figure; the route's '$1,000-$10,000+' describes the value of free services, not a payment.

steps.text: Confirm your household income is at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (check the current HHS poverty guidelines table).
Go to the official DOE page https://energy.gov/wap and open the 'how to apply' page to find your state's WAP administrator.
Contact your state's WAP office or local community action agency and complete the application with income documentation.
A certified auditor performs a home energy audit to determine the most cost-effective improvements.
Approved improvements (insulation, air sealing, HVAC, etc.) are installed at no cost to you by the agency's contractors.

steps.text: Place a trade using your credit — buy shares in an outcome you believe will happen
steps.warns: Upmore shows: You can lose the entire promotional credit value. Only trade if you understand the market.

steps.text: If your prediction is correct, shares settle at $1 each — withdraw realized gains to your bank or crypto wallet

routes.requirements: 18+, US resident (varies), smartphone with good camera, comfortable filming product videos, no following required for most UGC campaigns
routes.payout_timing: Payout added to virtual wallet on content approval; transfer to PayPal anytime (free-plan withdrawal limits may apply).
catches: The $100+/post, $60+/video, $15+/image figures are minimums ('earn from'), not typical or guaranteed pay — brands set the actual payout per job.
JoinBrands takes a platform fee on every creator payment: 20% on the free plan, 15% with Creator Pro ($10/month). Creator Pro's lower fee only pays for itself if you do real volume.
Free-plan creators face withdrawal limits on earnings (Creator Pro removes them).
You may have to purchase the product yourself upfront (reimbursed) or receive it free, depending on the campaign.
Some campaign types require posting to your own TikTok/Instagram/YouTube — your social reach affects which jobs you can win.
No jobs are guaranteed; marketplace is competitive and brand-selected.
Variable gig work, NOT fixed income: zero guaranteed campaigns, brands select which creators they accept, and content-rights terms vary per brief.

steps.text: Go to the official creator page https://JoinBrands.com/creator/ and click 'Get started - it's free' to create a creator account (you must be 18+ and in the USA, UK, Germany, Australia, or Canada).
Connect your social accounts (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Amazon — a plus for extra earning) and complete your creator profile.
Browse the job marketplace — every job shows the pay, product value, and commission upfront before you apply.
Apply to jobs that fit your content; the brand selects the creator.
If selected, receive or buy (reimbursed) the product and create the content per the brief.
Submit for approval — once approved, the payout is added to your virtual wallet, then transfer to PayPal. Expect 15-20% platform fee deducted.

routes.what: Sign up, apply to campaigns, create content
routes.reward: Typically pricing begins at $250 per asset (brand-set; pay may be PRODUCT-ONLY); paid by client no earlier than 30 days after campaign end; creator bears 2.9% PayPal fees; Cohley disclaims liability if client doesn't pay
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident (varies), smartphone with good camera, comfortable filming product videos, no following required for most UGC campaigns
routes.payout_timing: Paid by the client per the creative brief, no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date.
catches: The 'Typically pricing begins at $250 per asset' figure is brand-facing budget guidance, not a creator pay guarantee — actual compensation is set per creative brief by the client and can also be free product only.
Creators are paid by the CLIENT, not by Cohley: 'Creator shall be paid by Client in accordance with the Creative Brief' — Cohley explicitly disclaims liability if a client fails to pay.
Payment arrives no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date — slow compared to other platforms.
The creator bears all PayPal fees (2.9% of total compensation) plus taxes; fail to set up PayPal within 30 days of campaign end and you forfeit all compensation.
Pre-vetted creator network: you need an existing portfolio and to pass vetting — not open to beginners.
Content ownership/license terms are in the brand's favor per the creator terms (review the Ownership section before signing).
Variable gig work, NOT fixed income: zero guaranteed campaigns, brands select which creators they accept, and content-rights terms vary per brief.

steps.text: Create your free Cohley creator account and complete your profile with a name, email, country of residence, profile photo, and portfolio work samples (portfolio is required — vetting is not automatic).
Review and accept Cohley's Creator Terms & Conditions — note you are paid by the client, not Cohley, and you bear PayPal fees.
Get matched to brand briefs (AI-matched by niche and demographics); each brief states its compensation — confirm it is cash, not product-only, before accepting.
Deliver the assets per the brief (typical 21-34 second 9:16 video, ~1 week turnaround).
Set up your PayPal account within 30 days of the campaign end date or you forfeit compensation.
Receive payment per the creative brief, no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date, minus 2.9% PayPal fees.
